execution.terminal: Only final sample end may force a tagged close with the unchanged engine; report terminal count.
execution.sizing: Unchanged all-cash long/flat quote-fee model; no leverage, order book, partial fills or rounding model.

prefix_control.candidate: All four prior filtered curves have no terminal liquidation and must remain completely exact.
prefix_control.original: All four prior original curves have one explicit terminal close; its removal for extension must be witnessed, not silently treated as a discrepancy.

validation: Independent Decimal raw targets and gate admissions.
